pages.title: Making Krik
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Lutetium + 1 Osmium = 2 Krik

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 1652 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 6.$(br)Mining efficiency: 9.5.$(br)Material damage bonus: 4.1.$(br)Enchantability: 17.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 4, leggings 3, boots 2.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 2.0.$(br)Enchantability: 17.

pages.title: Weight-Based Flight
pages.text: Makes you float at a certain height depending on how much filled your inventory is. You can press the UP arrow or the DOWN arrow to float respectively up and down. You have a height limit you can't go over while floating, that limit depends on how full your inventory is (excluding the hotbar). There's also an HUD in the
bottom-right corner of the screen that shows you, your height level and your limit.

pages.title: Tool: Krik-Drives
pages.text: Activating the item launches the player in the general direction of where they are looking.

pages.title: Weapon: Flak
pages.text: Deals double damage to airborne entities and gives a short levitation debuff.
